question: Please tell us what are Crocodile and Daz Bonez’ favorite foods and most hated foods. I think a boss like Crocodile who likes Bananawani (Banana Crocodiles) wouldn’t eat bananas or crocodile meat. My older sister thinks he dislikes mandarin oranges (mikan). We got into a fight about whether it’s hard for him to remove his fake hand. Me and Mandarin Sister
answer: [Crocodile: Likes: Crocodile meat and tomatoes Dislikes: Ketchup · Daz Bones (Mr. 1): Likes: Raw Ham Dislikes: Grilled pork] This sounds about right!! The fact that he keeps crocodiles as pets doesn’t really affect what is difficult for him to eat. When you look at what these two like to eat they sure seem like an annoying pair to please.
name: Banana Me and Mandarin Sister
